retrievalProfile.description: A sophisticated studio portrait featuring a close-up subject with high-contrast lighting, textured elements like fur, and elegant serif typography integrated into the lower composition.

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, intimate head-and-shoulders portrait of a female subject with dark hair, set against a neutral dark grey background. The lighting is soft but directional, emphasizing facial contours and skin texture. A large, grey faux-fur element occupies the lower right foreground, providing a tactile contrast to the smooth skin. Typography is layered over the lower third, using a mix of classic serifs and flowing script.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's face as the primary focal point
Fur texture in the foreground creating depth
Typography anchored to the bottom right and left corners
Warm skin tones contrasting against a cool grey background
Hand-to-head pose creating a diagonal line through the frame
coreInvariants: Integrated thin-line border framing the right side

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered and scaled to a tight medium-close-up, filling approximately 70% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the large 'N' of the primary text.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eyes, moves down the arm to the script text on the left, then across to the large serif name on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal, concentrated in the upper corners and around the subject's head to maintain focus on the face.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the skin highlights and the dark background.
paletteRestrictions: Stick to earth tones and greyscale

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: High-contrast transitional serif and monoline script
letterConstructionRules: Primary name uses a large initial cap with an elongated swash tail
Secondary text is small, tracked out, and placed beneath the primary name
Tertiary text uses a thin, flowing script with overlapping loops
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'N' features a descending swash that underlines the rest of the word
The script 'k' and 'l' have exaggerated, rounded loops
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A bold, high-contrast serif for the name paired with a delicate, handwritten script for the title.
graphicDevices: Thin L-shaped border on the right and bottom edges

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary high-contrast serif look for a fashion aesthetic.
Matches the flowing, monoline script style for the secondary title.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a studio portrait of a woman with dark hair and warm skin tones against a dark grey background. Include a grey faux-fur texture in the bottom right foreground. Use soft, directional lighting to highlight facial features.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large serif name in the bottom right with a long swash on the first letter. Add a smaller sans-serif name below it. In the bottom left, add a thin script title. Include a very thin peach-colored border along the right and bottom edges.

verificationChecks: Is the typography placed in the lower third?
Does the skin tone look warm and bronzed?
Is the background a neutral dark grey?
Is there a visible contrast between the smooth skin and the textured fur?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the celebrity
postGenerationChecks: Check for clean typographic integration over texture
Ensure the skin tone remains natural and not overly orange
Verify the thin border is consistent and subtle
Confirm the subject's gaze is direct and engaging
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + Neutral Background + Foreground Texture (Fur/Fabric) + High-Contrast Serif Typography + Lower-Third Layout
